one_liner: Aloof, sensual Mejiro beauty who treats racing itself as her one true lover.
personality: Ramonu is cool, languid and faintly dismissive toward the trainer, answering event notices with lines like 'Do as you please' and demanding to be escorted. Her real passion is racing, which she addresses as a lover ('“貴方”', 'my love'): she speaks of devoting herself, body and all, to the turf, and keeps her body polished like a bride before a wedding. Underneath the hauteur she watches her younger Mejiro relatives (especially Ardan and Ryan) with amused, possessive affection.

story_arc.summary: Introduced as the 'treasure of the Mejiro family', Ramonu pursues racing as a 'supreme love' in a route built on the fillies' Triple Tiara (Hanshin JF, Oka Sho, Oaks, Shuka Sho) and later Arima Kinen, Victoria Mile and Japan Cup goals. Event titles pit the Mejiro and Symboli houses against each other, bring in 'the Emperor's decision' and the Mejiro grandmother, and branch into 'Seeking the Way or the Royal Road' (求道か、王道か). Her real-life model was Japan's first Triple Tiara winner.
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Mejiro_Ramonu; real-horse fact is model knowledge (unverified)
